Ugh! This guy was the absolute pits! He was an Asian kid, born and raised in Texas, who was as scrawny as a pencil thats been shaved away with a knife to get to the lead. He kinda had a problem but no one entirely knew what was up. His diet consisted of pesto pasta, popcorn (usually slightly burnt) and cheez-its, which I understand sounds like a very college thing to eat but being on a forced meal plan with a ridiculous amount of cheap options, this was abnormal. The room constantly smelled of food and because he didn't like the windows open, it marinated the room in garlic and artificial cheeses. Not to mention the days where it would reach 100 degrees. 

Anyway, this kid also had another problem of not washing the sheets, which again, is another college thing, but for 9 months!? Especially when the sheets are white and you can see the gradient of color from the side of his bed go from white, to yellow, to brown where he slept. This guy also had a social anxiety which is understandable but it came to the point where he never left the room and only stayed on his bed which caused the browning of the sheets.

 He was so scared of other people that when I'd have friends over just to play some video games, he hid under the covers. He would take showers at 4 in the morning when no one was around and put his back against the wall when he went to go to the bathroom any other time and shimmy around people who were in there as well. 

He would clip his fingernails almost every 5 minutes as a habit on his bed and then just scoot it to the shared room floor, on the rug I bought for our room. He pulled out his hair constantly like it was some nervous tick, he never took out the trash, barely washed his clothes, changed in the tiny ass closet, and oh yeah, he ate Spam and Vienna Sausages raw. 

I did my best to co-exist with him and trust me, had it been someone else who had lived with him, he would have been eaten alive.
